description:
## Site
apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/loop.ex L535-555

The non-tool decide_next clause inlines exactly the pattern that
\`drain_steering_into_messages/1\` already encapsulates a few lines
below:

\`\`\`elixir
defp decide_next(_terminal_reason, store) do
  case PendingMessageQueue.drain(store.loop.steering_queue) do
    {[], _} -> drain_follow_up_into_messages(store)
    {steers, q} ->
      store = ...put_in...
      emit_queue_update(store)
      {:continue, store}
  end
end

defp drain_steering_into_messages(store) do
  case PendingMessageQueue.drain(store.loop.steering_queue) do
    {[], _} -> store
    {steers, q} ->
      store = ...put_in...
      emit_queue_update(store)
      store
  end
end
\`\`\`

## Change
Have the helper return a tagged tuple so the caller knows whether
anything moved:

\`\`\`elixir
@spec drain_steering_into_messages(store) :: {:drained | :empty, store}
defp drain_steering_into_messages(store) do
  case PendingMessageQueue.drain(store.loop.steering_queue) do
    {[], _} -> {:empty, store}
    {steers, q} ->
      store = ...put_in...
      emit_queue_update(store)
      {:drained, store}
  end
end
\`\`\`

Then:

\`\`\`elixir
defp decide_next(:tool_use, store) do
  {_, store} = drain_steering_into_messages(store)
  {:continue, store}
end

defp decide_next(_terminal_reason, store) do
  case drain_steering_into_messages(store) do
    {:drained, store} -> {:continue, store}
    {:empty, store} -> drain_follow_up_into_messages(store)
  end
end
\`\`\`

start_run/1 also calls drain_steering_into_messages and currently
ignores the tag — no semantic change there, just match against
\`{_, store}\`.

## Tests
- All 138 octo_pi_agent tests should keep passing without changes.
- The opi-tze.3 \"queue_update events\" describe stays green
  (emit_queue_update is fired in exactly the same situations).

## Why this isn't done in opi-tze
Surfaced during post-review of the opi-tze epic; deferred so the
queueing fixes could land minimal/atomic. The duplication isn't a
bug — both paths are correct — but it's a maintenance hazard:
adding a new emission concern (e.g. telemetry around drain count)
would require the change in two places.
title: Consolidate decide_next non-tool branch into drain_steering_into_messages
